reason: SeasonalVenueAvailability declares endsAt?: string. Omission represents no supported exact final end; it does not add or change operating evidence or retirement time.

(expiryBasis === exact ? listingExpiresAt : undefined), so null and omission resolve identically for these non-exact listings.
